---
name: "💡 Idea / Proposal"
about: Suggest a new direction, feature, or experimental improvement.
title: "[IDEA]: "
labels: spike, enhancement
---

### 🌟 The "Big Picture"
What is the core idea? (e.g., "Implement a 'What-If' mode to simulate warehouse layout changes").

### 🚀 Added Value
Why is this worth building? How does it make the Warehouse Dispatcher better or more "Senior"?

### 🛠 Potential Implementation
High-level thoughts on how to build it:
- Which slice would it live in?
- Would it require new dependencies (e.g., Kafka, Redis)?

### ⚖️ Pros vs. Cons
- **Pros:** (e.g., "Makes the API more flexible for different clients").
- **Cons/Risks:** (e.g., "Increases architectural complexity").

### 💬 Open Questions
Is there anything you're unsure about? (e.g., "Will this impact solver performance?").
